description.value: This McDonald's on 152 Street in Surrey is a drive-through fast food location serving burgers, breakfast, and McCafé coffee to go. It sits in a busy commercial corridor and is wheelchair accessible, making it a convenient roadside stop for touring cyclists cutting through the Fraser Valley region. The broad menu and takeout-friendly format make it a reliable resupply point for calories on the road.
